newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Thursday:

Spokesman Gery Kiely said the Commission had adopted a proposal for regulations on identifying and tracing cattle and on labelling of beef and beef products. Kiely said the decision on whether or not to label beef and beef products was voluntary for operators and organisations and that labels could include information such as country of origin or method of fattening.

Spokesman Peter Guilford said the Commission had launched a formal complaint against Indonesia's policy on car imports with the World Trade Organisation in Geneva on Thursday. The Commission is concerned about discrimination towards cars imported from the EU and other continents contrary to the basic principles of the multilateral trading system, Guilford said.

Asked about the Commission's reaction to German Chancellor Kohl's declaration about a possible "Maastricht 3", spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said it understood it as a desire to go further in the process if the current inter-governmental conference did not succeed and not as a doubt on the outcome of that conference.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/861: Commission adopts proposals on identification of cattle and labelling of beef and beef products.
- IP/96/876/rev2: Commission defines principles for future contractual relations with certain countries in South Eastern Europe.
- IP/96/883: International forum on public services: the Commission is counting on the citizen qua consumer to accelerate liberalisation.
- IP/96/884: Commissioner van den Broek visits Slovenia.
- IP/96/885: The EU requests WTO consultations over Indonesia's car policy.
- IP/96/886: European conference on "Tobacco or health" in Helsinki.
- IP/96/888: Commission and Committee of Regions take part in seminar on the development of the Atlantic Arc in Santiago de Compostela.
- Speech/96/233: Speech by Commissioner Christos Papoutsis on the European policy in favour of small and medium-sized enterprises.
- Speech/96/234: Speech by Commissioner Padraig Flynn on "Tobacco or health".

- Proposal for a Council regulation establishing a system for the identification and registration of bovine animals and proposal for a Council regulation regarding the labelling of beef and beef products.
- Eurostat news release No 65/96: Smaller EU12 trade deficit with African, Caribbean & Pacific countries.
- Eurostat, statistics in focus, external trade No 1996/9: European Union (EU12) trade with African, Caribbean and Pacific countries (ACP).
